name: Data.log_w_le
summary: Exponentiate: w(D, j, σ) ≤ nominalWeight(D, σ) + x(D)⁴² and nominalWeight(D, σ)·e^{1/x(D)} ≥ nominalWeight(D, σ)·(1 + 1/x(D)), so it suffices that x(D)⁴² ≤ nominalWeight(D, σ)/x(D), a comparison of monomials.

steps.claim: Write ν for the real number nominalWeight(D, σ) > 0. Since w(D, j, σ) > 0, log w(D, j, σ) ≤ log ν + 1/x(D) is equivalent to w(D, j, σ) ≤ exp(log ν + 1/x(D)) = ν·exp(1/x(D)); by w(D, j, σ) ≤ ν + x(D)⁴² (`w_le_nominalWeight_add` with hj) and exp(1/x(D)) ≥ 1 + 1/x(D) it suffices that ν + x(D)⁴² ≤ ν·(1/x(D) + 1), i.e. x(D)⁴² ≤ ν·x(D)⁻¹; the positivity side conditions are closed with `HasLogBound.pos`.
steps.lean:
grw [log_le_iff_le_exp, w_le_nominalWeight_add _ hj, exp_add, exp_log, ← add_one_le_exp, mul_add,
    add_comm] <;> simp [HasLogBound.pos D, -nominalWeight, -w]

steps.claim: x(D)⁴² ≤ nominalWeight(D, σ)·x(D)⁻¹, a comparison of monomials in the scales, by `le_of_hasLogBound`. With the exponents as this reader computes them from the instances (instance search's own choice is not recorded): the upper exponent of x(D)⁴² is 42·logX(D), the lower exponent of the right side is logB(D) − logX₁(D) − logX(D), and 42·logX(D) < logB(D) − logX₁(D) − logX(D) by the scale conditions.
